rows.grounds: locative adverb indicating the place just described
feminine nominative singular participle agreeing with mahākālī

items.question: Where is Mahākālī situated and with which attendant hosts?
premises: She is accompanied by attendant hosts.
The hosts appear in the instrumental case.
items.inference: Mahākālī resides in that place together with her attendant hosts.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tatra depends on the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: There Mahākālī is situated together with her attendant hosts.
